assertion.statement: A changelog entry in Traefik 3.0.0 (filed under the Documentation section) states that the Kubernetes version for the v3 Helm chart was updated, without stating the previous or new version or any operational effect.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: the changelog line does not state the Kubernetes version before or after (and does not say whether the supported-version requirement changed or only its documentation), so no change type can be asserted; applicability: without the new Kubernetes version requirement, no exposure predicate (e.g. cluster-version out-of-range of the new requirement) can be written; consequence: the evidence does not say what happens to environments running other Kubernetes versions (e.g. whether chart installation is gated) or whether the update is documentation-only
